text:
B: Alright. Can you hear me?
A: Yeah. Hiya.
B: Darren.
A: Bianca.
B: Where are you, then?
A: Wolverhampton. Well, Bilston, kind of just outside.
B: Maidstone, me. Kent.
A: Oh right.
B: What d'you do?
A: Erm, I'm at uni. Second year, Accounting and Finance, at Wolverhampton.
B: Accounting. Sensible.
A: Yeah, that's kind of why I picked it. It pays, and there's always jobs, do you know what I mean. I'm not like, passionate about it.
B: Fair enough. Most people aren't passionate about their job, to be fair.
A: What do you do?
B: Bins. Loader on the council rounds. Six o'clock start.
A: Oh, my boyfriend does early ones as well. Well, nights mostly. He's at a warehouse off the M6.
B: Nights is worse. I couldn't do nights.
A: He's knackered all the time. But it means I get the flat to myself, so.
B: Every cloud.
A: Yeah, basically.
B: You go in every day, to uni?
A: Most days. Bus into the city campus. It was late again this morning, like twenty minutes. Nearly missed my seminar.
B: We get people moaning at us about being late. It's never us, it's the parked cars. You can't get the wagon down half the roads round here, people park either side, and then they ring up and say we skipped them.
A: Do people ring up a lot?
B: All the time. And the recycling, mate. People put anything in. Nappies. Garden hoses.
A: Hoses?
B: Wrapped round the bin drum. Twice this month.
A: That's grim.
B: It is what it is.
A: Do you like it, though? Like, the job.
B: It's alright. I've never missed a start in eleven years. Wouldn't say I like it. My back don't like it, put it that way.
A: Eleven years without missing one? That's kind of impressive.
B: Just get up and go. My missus is in care, she does worse hours than me.
A: Oh, my mum did care homes. When I was little. Like, long shifts, nights, weekends, all of it.
B: Tracey says it's harder than bins. She's probably right.
A: My mum used to come in and just fall asleep on the settee. In her uniform. That's partly why I'm doing accounting, tbh. I don't want to be skint like that, do you know what I mean.
B: Yeah. I get that.
A: Not being funny about care work. It's just a lot for not much.
B: No, it is. They don't pay them enough. Never have.
A: Mm.
B: You from Wolverhampton originally, then?
A: Erm, Romania originally, but I came over when I was eight. So basically from Wolves now.
B: You've got the accent and everything.
A: Yeah, people don't believe me.
B: You go back?
A: Most summers, to see my nan. Fly from Birmingham. I'd rather go somewhere with a nice hotel though, to be honest. Like Dubai.
B: Not me. Can't stand airports. All that standing about.
A: I just bring a bigger bag than you're allowed and hope.
B: Ha. Does that work?
A: Mostly. We was nearly caught once, but—
